extraction.summary: The requirement document is a bank tender for a customer web portal where business customers raise trade finance requests such as letters of credit, guarantees, bills and remittances online instead of at a branch. The portal must connect to the bank's existing core banking, SWIFT and screening systems, run on the bank's own infrastructure, and be supported for five years with on-site staff.

unclear_points.why: The document gives 6 months in one place, 12 months in another and a phase table running to about 261 days.
unclear_points.quote: The solution must be implemented as per project scope within 6 months in totality from the date of issuance of purchase order.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 6.2 states the solution must be implemented within 6 months of the purchase order, while Part 7 (General Requirements, item 12) states 12 months and the phase table shows Phase 2 going live at T+261 days. Kindly confirm the single applicable deadline for full go-live.

unclear_points.why: Support charges are quoted for 4 years after a 1-year warranty in one place and ATS for 5 years from go-live in another.
unclear_points.quote: The bidders shall quote Support Charges for the Solution for a period of 4 years after the initial comprehensive onsite warranty period of 1 years in the commercial bid (Format 8.12).
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 5.30 asks for support charges for 4 years after a 1-year warranty, while Part 7 item 23 says ATS of 5 years from go-live will be considered for evaluation. Kindly clarify the exact warranty and ATS periods and their start dates.

unclear_points.why: The help desk clause asks for at least 4 L1 persons, while the commercial format prices 1 person per day for TCO.
unclear_points.quote: However, for the TCO purpose 1-person day (1 shift x 1 person) x 365 for each year will be considered.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Part 7 (Help Desk Requirements) asks for a minimum of 4 L1 persons on a 2-shift basis, while Format 8.12 Note 8 and Tables IV to VI use 1 person x 365 days. Kindly confirm the number of L1, L2 and developer resources to be deployed on-site.

unclear_points.why: Sizing depends on user information the document says is given elsewhere, but no numbers are stated.
unclear_points.quote: The sizing of the above components should be based on the User information mentioned elsewhere in the RFP and application specific requirements.
unclear_points.prebid_query: The Infrastructure Sizing section refers to user information mentioned elsewhere in the RFP. Kindly provide the number of corporate customers, bank users, concurrent users and expected transactions per month for sizing.

unclear_points.why: The Bank may choose cloud or on-premises later, yet the solution is also described as hosted on-premises and as 100% cloud native.
unclear_points.quote: Bank at any point of time may decide and advice vendor to implement the solution in the cloud or on premise as per the choice of bank.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Kindly confirm whether the initial deployment is on-premises at the Bank's data centres or on cloud, and whether any cloud hosting charges are to be borne by the bidder.

unclear_points.why: The scope is described as indicative and open to change at any phase.
unclear_points.quote: The below mentioned SoW is indicative in nature and the Department reserves the right to modify/ change the scope of work at any phase.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 6.1 states the scope of work is indicative. Kindly provide the final list of products, functions and integrations to be delivered in Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 3, and how scope changes will be priced.

unclear_points.why: The number and nature of API developments in the core banking system are left open.
unclear_points.quote: Customization / API Development under Bank-end System i.e., CBS Finacle 10.x is to be undertaken as per requirements.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Part 7 item 13 requires API development under Finacle CBS 10.x as per requirements. Kindly provide the list of APIs and the expected number of integration points.

unclear_points.why: Migration of existing data is conditional and no volume or source is given.
unclear_points.quote: In case of migration of existing data is required or proposed by the Bank, the successful Bidder should facilitate the same without any additional cost for the Bank.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Part 7 item 9 mentions migration of existing data if required. Kindly state whether data migration is required and, if so, the source systems and approximate record volumes.

unclear_points.why: Only a single line asks for an online help or chat bot, with no detail on what it should answer.
unclear_points.quote: The Solution should provide Online Help/Chat bot service to guide corporate during input.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Clause 5.16 requires an online help or chat bot service. Kindly specify whether it is a rule-based guide or an AI assistant, the languages, and the expected volume of queries.

unclear_points.why: The portal must support multichannel but the channels are not named.
unclear_points.quote: The proposed Trade Finance Customer portal should support multichannel.
unclear_points.prebid_query: Item 4 of Clause 6.1 requires the portal to support multichannel. Kindly list the channels required, including whether a native mobile app is expected.
